meta.meta_description: Learn about AfriGold Hub, our leadership, operating principles, governance model, and mission to make African artisanal gold transparent and investable.

hero.headline: A disciplined gold platform built in the field
hero.description: AfriGold Hub brings licensed mining operations, chemical-free gravity processing, investor-grade reporting, and community-first governance into one transparent gold production platform.

badge.text: Licensed operations across seven African markets

story.headline: Built for trust, not speculation
story.description: The AfriGold Hub model was shaped by a simple observation: artisanal gold can be highly productive, but it only becomes investable when the operation is licensed, documented, and governed with discipline. We built our platform around that standard.
paragraphs: Our team combines field operators, finance professionals, compliance specialists, and ESG advisors who have worked across East, West, and Southern African mineral corridors.

Instead of selling exposure to a vague commodity opportunity, we give partners visibility into the actual production chain: where ore is extracted, how it is processed, how bars are assayed, how buyers settle, and how distributions are calculated.

items.title: Document everything
items.description: Every stage produces a record - from pit weight tickets to assay certificates and sale receipts.

items.title: Keep processing clean
items.description: Our gravity concentration circuits use water and density separation, eliminating mercury, cyanide, and toxic tailings.

items.title: Share the economics
items.description: Partners receive monthly reporting that connects production, sales, costs, net profit, and distribution calculations.

items.title: Protect the licence
items.description: Compliance, community agreements, and environmental controls are treated as operating assets, not paperwork.

team.headline: Operators, finance minds, and compliance discipline
team.description: AfriGold Hub is led by a compact team with direct accountability for production, finance, investor relations, and regulatory integrity.

governance.headline: Controls that make the operation auditable
governance.description: Our governance model is designed around clear records, accountable ownership, and investor access to the documents that matter.
items: Monthly P&L review by finance leadership
Third-party assay certificates for produced bars
Central compliance register for licences and permits
Chain-of-custody logs from extraction through sale
Structured partner agreements with defined rights
Site access and document review for qualified partners
